labels._desc: System A sends data to MQ; systems B, C and a new system consume from MQ on demand, and a system that no longer needs the data simply stops consuming.
labels.t_prod: Produce data and send it to MQ
labels.t_new:
New system needs data,
consumes directly from MQ
labels.t_need:
Any system that needs
the data consumes it
from MQ itself
labels.t_cancel:
If a system does not need
the data, cancel its
consumption of MQ messages
